revision_summary: Overall the trajectory read and outcome reclassification (dq, credit_below_670_no_alternative) are well-grounded and should stay. Three targeted fixes needed on rerun: (1) Fix script_coverage section id 'tax_credit_qualifier' at ts 02:31 to 'credit_qualifier' — the schema section referenced is qualifiers.credit_qualifier, not the tax-credit-disclosure item, and the current label misrepresents the schema. (2) Soften the cross_sell_miss claim at 00:58 — the transcript around 00:58-01:09 is garbled/crosstalk ('I think you're interested in solar' / 'No. It's Okay.'), and treating it as a clean, confident roofing cross-sell signal overstates what the transcript supports; recommend downgrading confidence or explicitly flagging transcript ambiguity in the primary stewart_read rather than only in alternative_hypothesis. (3) Reconsider classifying the credit disclosure (02:34) as an 'objections' entry of type 'cost' — it reads more accurately as a qualifier/hard-DQ event than a customer objection to be 'resolved,' and the resolved:false framing may mislead aggregate objection-handling stats. Minor secondary notes: the bill figure '$2.24' interpreted as '$224' should carry its caveat into bill_anchor_audit itself, not just cherry_pick_moments; and the customer addresses the rep as 'Buffy' at 02:56 which is worth a footnote against the asserted rep_name 'Bucky.'
